assumption.name: P ≠ NP (tutorial)
assumption.definition: Some language in NP is outside P.
assumption.model: Deterministic decision on complete binary inputs.
assumption.quantifiers: For some language in NP, for every fixed polynomial running-time bound, no deterministic decider satisfies that bound.
assumption.conventions: Disposable contributor exercise outside the four launch assumptions.
assumption.access: Standard definitions of P and NP. The cited tutorial paper uses NP-completeness to derive a running-time consequence.
